short: Deliberately valuing a position away from fair value while reporting it as correct.
graphHint: The confirmed case: (:Incident)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(:Position POS-TP); its full trail is the S2 chronology.

short: An instrument that trades rarely, so its price is estimated rather than observed.
graphHint: (:RiskAttribute {type:'liquidityTier', value:'illiquid'}) linked via HAS_RISK_ATTRIBUTE from Instrument and Position; scope of rule R7.

short: The documented method by which a position is valued.
graphHint: (:ValuationMethodology) linked by VALUED_BY from Position; changes are (:MethodologyChange) events via CHANGED_TO — triggers of R1/R2.

short: A reference curve used to value instruments lacking observable prices.
graphHint: (:MarketPrice {source:'proxy-model'}) COMPARED_WITH observed prices, divergenceBps on the relationship; the Explore price chart.

short: Independent Price Verification: periodic check of trader marks against independent sources.
graphHint: (:IPVReview) events via REVIEWED_BY; divergenceBps drives rules R2, R3 (challenge) and R5 in S2's expected-vs-observed.

short: Periodic market-conformity review of illiquid books (acronym to be confirmed with the customer).
graphHint: (:MAPReview) events via REVIEWED_BY; required by R4 (after escalation) and R7 (periodic / post regime break).

short: First line of defence: controls owned and executed by the business itself.
graphHint: Desk-side events: (:Approval) by desk actors, (:Control) via SUBJECT_TO_CONTROL; R8 tests their independence from the position's desk.

short: Decomposition of daily P&L into its explained drivers.
graphHint: (:Control {kind:'attribution'}) events; required by R6 within slaDays of a persistent PnLSignal.

short: The residual of daily P&L that attribution cannot account for.
graphHint: (:PnLSignal {unexplainedPct, consecutiveDays}) via GENERATED_SIGNAL; the trigger of rule R6.

short: A manual replacement of a system or quoted price by a trader mark.
graphHint: (:PriceOverride {deviationBps, side}) via OVERRIDDEN_BY; triggers of R3 and R4 — the weekly series on POS-TP.

short: An observation that stays below alerting threshold on its own.
graphHint: Every event node in S1; each is sub-threshold, the S1 ranking counts their co-occurrence around a Position.

short: Several weak signals occurring together around the same object.
graphHint: S1's score: (signals + overrides + methodology changes) × distinct broken rules per Position; the community IS the pattern.

short: Re-applying the lessons of one confirmed case to the whole population.
graphHint: S3/S4: (:Pattern)-[:REQUIRES]->(:RiskAttribute|:GovernanceGap) matched against every Position; score = satisfied / total.

short: Validating a method against known outcomes withheld from it.
graphHint: S4 link prediction: six HAS_RISK_ATTRIBUTE links removed at generation (holdout_links.json); recovery is shown on screen.

short: A densely connected group of nodes found by a graph algorithm.
graphHint: GDS Louvain writes communityId on nodes; S1 colours the selected position's community and greys the rest.

short: Inferring relationships that are likely but not yet present in the graph.
graphHint: S4: gds.nodeSimilarity over the Position–RiskAttribute bipartite projection; candidates for typed holes, validated against the holdout.

short: A case matching some but not all conditions of a pattern.
graphHint: S4 score strictly between 0 and 1; the 0.5–1.0 band is the early-detection story — the pattern forming before the loss.

short: A pattern match that human review dismisses (false) or confirms (true).
graphHint: POS-TP is the confirmed case; POS-FP the deliberate false positive whose controls did fire (only R2/R4/R6 paperwork gaps).

short: An abrupt change in market conditions that invalidates previous calibrations.
graphHint: (:RegimeBreak {at: 2022-09-30}); rule R7 requires a MAPReview within regimeSlaDays after it.
